item.title: Two Weeks of Claude Breaking and Fixing Staging: The Chaos Loop Behind the Claude Docs Launch
item.description: How the Claude Docs team let Claude stress, break, and repair a production-like staging cluster for about two weeks before launch, which decisions stayed with a human, why the service runs on Rust with minimal dependencies, and what the launch results and inference bill looked like.

item.title: Codenotch: Screen-Edge Widget for Tracking AI Coding Assistant Limits
item.description: Codenotch places a compact screen-edge widget on macOS and Windows to monitor usage quotas, reset timers, and live agent status across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.

item.title: ECC: An Open-Source Operator System for Optimizing AI Agent Performance
item.description: Explore ECC, an open-source operator system that optimizes token usage, preserves session memory, and enables continuous skill extraction for Claude Code and Cursor.
